title: NBC's Mike Tomlin gives blunt assessment of Steelers' loss to Bengals

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NBC's Mike Tomlin gives blunt assessment of Steelers' loss to Bengals
sources.description: Mike Tomlin tells it like it is. After 19 seasons leading Pittsburgh (2007-2025), he also slipped and referred to the team as "we" in his postgame comments.
